purpose: Fixed fail-closed controls paired with the N17 known-answer specification
execution_boundary: Static negative-control specification only; no code, digest, verifier, parent, registry or fixture execution
common_expectation: Each control is a fixed engineering case. It must refuse or produce an identified failing row, preserve canonical inputs, emit no digest or partial preimage, preserve output/workspace canaries, and retain the unmodified baseline for recheck.

fixtures.mutation: flip one independently selected raw byte
flip one manifest or page byte, then restore the unmodified baseline
change one format byte
0 to 1
replace one linkage byte
fixtures.required_disposition: REFUSE_SELECTOR or reviewed row failure; no digest

fixtures.mutation: change one individually selected source field byte
fixtures.required_disposition: R26 digest mismatch or reviewed field-row failure; no R27 result

fixtures.mutation: change one linkage byte
reorder two keys without changing values
remove one default separator space
change ASCII escape spelling for a selected control/quote/backslash
interpret a selected float32 span as another dtype
change one dimension or stride so the span no longer matches
swap two source-sorted keys
swap two sorted identifiers or alter one identifier byte
remove or change one required gate
fixtures.required_disposition: policy row failure; no terminal continuity claim

fixtures.mutation: remove, add or change the active promotion
fixtures.required_disposition: promotion row failure; no authority or promotion

fixtures.mutation: replace a future recomputed R26 digest with the retained witness literal
fixtures.required_disposition: implementation review failure; literal path forbidden; no digest credit

fixtures.mutation: treat absent as null, or null as absent
overflow selector, shape, input-length or output-length arithmetic

freeze_requirements: exact mutation offset or map selector
one exact expected refusal/result code after review
independent review before preregistration or admission
retention_rules: negatives are not a tunable search
no threshold relaxation, expected-value change or control deletion after exposure
a consumed failed candidate requires a new identity; no retry or rerun
a negative failure never establishes positive continuity
current_blocker: The full fixed mutation suite still lacks frozen mutation offsets/input hashes/refusal codes and reviewed fixture admission. Fresh short-output SHA canary and wrong-scalar/null-vs-absent static checks are narrow controls only, not replacements for all 20 mutational fixtures.
